title: Safe minimal baseline: OS D3D12 (no Agility, no DXR) to confirm swapchain path
purpose: Prove the core Win32 + DXGI + D3D12 swapchain loop is healthy independent of Agility/DXR.

steps.detail: Add a CMake option PLASMADX_MINIMAL_BASELINE. When ON, skip DXR init entirely and force OS D3D12.
In baseline mode, render a cycling color gradient only; log frames per second every 2 seconds.
Update README with instructions for toggling baseline mode to bisect issues.

acceptance: App runs for minutes without crash showing animated clear, proving baseline stability
Turning off baseline mode restores normal DXR path
